items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, old Barnaback, that's you. [INTERVIEWEE] It's more like bunk, huh? They bought bunk teeth, maybe they'll buy me some teeth.

ctx.x: Well, the original drummer with the group was Bob McIntyre. And, well, a couple months back, Bob's wife had a baby. And, naturally, Bob had to give more time to his family, you know, and he couldn't get out the way he wanted to make these jobs at night. And, then, John Joyce, JJ started playing with us. And, from what I hear, I don't know, it might just be a rumor. But, JJ Joyce has won the Trap Drumming Championship at Mississippi State for about four years in a row. Now, I don't know how authentic that is, but…
It's more like bunk, huh? They bought bunk teeth, maybe they'll buy me some teeth. Well, I might get lucky one day.
